statement: Organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP training run are headquartered in >= 4 jurisdictions (Epoch AI, snapshot 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Far below threshold: all known >=1e26 runs belong to organisations in a single jurisdiction (Bloc A). Bloc B flagships estimated ~1e25; no third jurisdiction near 1e26.

items.summary: Epoch AI: every model at the capability frontier since 2023 came from Bloc A; Bloc B models trailed by ~7 months on average. No other jurisdiction near the frontier.
items.detail: Epoch data insight 'Bloc B AI models have lagged the Bloc A frontier by 7 months on average since 2023'.

items.summary: The leading Bloc B flagship of spring 2026 was estimated at ~1e25 FLOP, about 10x below the threshold; the developer disclosed no compute.
items.detail: DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Bloc B), ~9.7e24 FLOP per DatacentersX table. Release date approximate (April 2026).

items.summary: With the new record run estimated at ~9.4e26 FLOP, all 4 notable models above 1e26 FLOP in Epoch's database belong to 2 organisations headquartered in one jurisdiction.
items.detail: Epoch: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-4.5 (OpenAI), Grok 4, Grok 3 (xAI) - all 'Bloc A'.

items.summary: Epoch AI chip-imports explorer: of cumulative AI compute delivered 2022-H1 2026, ~72% went to Bloc A and ~10% to Bloc B; the largest third jurisdiction held ~5%. Compute needed for 1e26 runs is concentrated in two jurisdictions.
items.detail: Bloc A 19.8M H100e (72%), Bloc B 2.6M (10%), Bloc C 1.4M (5%), Bloc I 0.7M (2%).

items.summary: Sovereign-model releases outside the two blocs in 2026 were small mixture-of-experts models trained on 12-24T tokens, well below 1e25 FLOP; none approached the 1e26 threshold.
items.detail: Examples: Kolibri (Bloc D sovereign MoE, 78B total/3.5B active, 24T tokens, arXiv 2610.31945); LLM-jp-4 (Bloc N, 8B and 32B-A3B, ~12T tokens, arXiv 2610.19331). Dates approximate (late Oct 2026). Rough compute 6*N_active*D << 1e25.

items.summary: Undisclosed compute for several Bloc A and Bloc B flagships makes the jurisdiction count a lower bound; but the missing estimates are mainly for Bloc A firms, so at most 2 jurisdictions are plausible at phase end.
items.detail: Google, Anthropic, Meta flagships lack Epoch estimates; Bloc B labs (DeepSeek, Alibaba, ByteDance, Moonshot) disclose little compute.
